reason: Adds a new helper method and refactors a few views to use it with equivalent semantics (mutating the same shape in place, clearing alternates by default), so behavior should be preserved, but it touches core RazorPage display logic used across all views so subtle regressions in shape morphing (e.g. ChildContent handling) could have broad effects.
